# The Method Room

> The Method Room is a women-only, boutique reformer Pilates studio at 1050–1052 London Road, Thornton Heath, South London (CR7 7ND). Small-group classes with a maximum of eight reformers, for all levels. Tagline: "Your Body, Your Flow."

## Key facts
- Location: 1050–1052 London Road, Thornton Heath, Surrey CR7 7ND. Serves South London. Closest areas (within about 3 miles): Croydon, Mitcham, Norbury, Streatham, South Norwood, Crystal Palace and Tooting. Also serves Streatham Vale, Streatham Common, Furzedown, Upper Norwood, Selhurst, Pollards Hill, Beulah Hill, Broad Green, West Croydon, Addiscombe, Shirley, Purley, Coulsdon, Sutton, Carshalton, Wallington, Tooting Bec, Balham, Dulwich, Sydenham, Penge.
- Studio type: women-only reformer Pilates studio. Classes are 50 minutes with a maximum of 8 per class.
- Classes: Reformer Foundations (beginner), Reformer Flow (beginner and beyond), Reformer Strength (advanced), and Private Reformer (1:1 or 2:1).
- Instructors hold a mix of qualifications (including STOTT, HFE, BASI and London Pilates Academy). Some are pre/postnatal trained.
- Opening hours: classes run at scheduled times that vary day to day. Access is by booking/appointment only; see the online schedule.
- Booking: online via the schedule on the homepage (Mindbody). Questions by email or WhatsApp.
- Pricing (see site for current prices): drop-in £25; intro offer 2 classes for £30; class packs of 5, 10 and 20; private 1:1 £70; duo private £85; monthly memberships (Essential, Signature, Elite).
- Cancellation: 24 hours' notice required.
